### THREE OPEN ITEMS, each needs its OWN change -- none is a ride-along
  a) PROJECTION BUG. Curation does not follow the catalog: a 13th cloud game stays invisible until
     someone remembers. Correct fix = house-scope the projection. Touches the SHARED renderer for
     every Firestore hub. Naive fix (add 'games' to a child's catalogCategories) drags 22 games from
     8 OTHER houses onto this hub, because the missing house filter is DELIBERATE --
     catalogCrossHouse:true is load-bearing on aws-ccp and azure-fundamentals.
  b) `.applet` KEY GAP. The renderer strips .lab/.quiz/.presentation/.module/.tool from an href to
     build a cover key but NOT .applet, so `x.applet.html` -> `x.applet` -> has a dot -> fails SLUG
     -> NO KEY AT ALL. 4 cloud games use .applet hrefs; THREE resolved by pure coincidence because
     their title slug matched the published filename. Shelf read "12 covers, 1 icon" and I nearly
     shipped past it. Covers now published under all three keys as a workaround. One word fixes it
     and changes key derivation for EVERY hub.
  c) Hubs(11) shelf does not collapse -- renders via the child-hub cartridge path, not
     renderSection, so it has no toggle. Operator has not ruled on whether it should.

### COVER KEY HAS THREE SHAPES (earned the hard way, 4 rounds)
  1 catalog `id`  2 href basename  3 slug of the title. Tried in order, icon only if all three miss.
  id and basename are DIFFERENT strings (`cloud-az104-ch01` vs `az104-ch01-prerequisites`).
  Curated Firestore items carry NO id, so key 2 or 3 is all they have.
  Resolution is URL GUESS + onerror, NEVER a manifest fetch: covers/manifest.json stays hub-only so
  hub-registry-audit.js:468 (one FAIL per orphan cover, and it IS the deploy gate) never fires.

### NEXT BUILD: THE NINES -- Mini Metro for cloud capacity
Spec: _docs/features/GAME_THE_NINES_DESIGN.md. Nancy's three blockers RESOLVED before code:
  MODEL   backlog integrator + M/M/1-shaped latency (rises at 70%, bends 85%, vertical near 1.0),
          loss on backlog bound. NOT a saturation stopwatch -- that teaches 95% utilisation is safe
          and cannot express what a queue is for.
  SPREAD  a 2nd AZ SPLITS capped capacity rather than adding it, and some seeds NEVER fail an AZ,
          so the concentrated player wins those. Failure domains must sometimes LOSE or it is a
          lecture with a timer.
  SCOPE   tier-adjacent edges only (edge->balancer->compute->cache->data). No cycles representable,
          flow is a forward sweep. ~1,500 lines; arbitrary topology was costed at ~3,000.
  CATALOG file it category:'games' (correct, consistent with 15 siblings) and CURATE it onto the
          shelf like the other 12. Do NOT use category:'cloud' to force visibility.
Stack: GameTracker.js · ArcadeScoreModal.js · GameScoreboard.js · HexworthGameAudio.js. Canvas.
